name: CampusZen
description: Agent plugins for CampusZen: an MCP server, agent skills, and an A2A card for the Indian college student social network.

skills.name: campuszen-community-explorer
skills.description: Discover, list, and summarize campus communities by name or college slug.

skills.name: campuszen-events-browser
skills.description: List upcoming or past campus events, optionally filtered by college.

skills.name: campuszen-leaderboard-reader
skills.description: Read public leaderboards of top contributors by reputation.

skills.name: campuszen-post-publisher
skills.description: Create and read feed posts within the authenticated user's campus feed.
